blurb: An agent class that bynk.schema.lock records can't just disappear from source: it must be given one fate, either `agent New replaces Old` (its data moves) or `removed agent Old` (its data is deleted). Giving a name two fates is a conflict: renamed twice, renamed and removed, or removed twice. A rename onto a class that already has recorded history of its own is also refused, since it would merge two histories and Cloudflare refuses a rename onto an existing namespace. Decide what becomes of the old class, and declare that once.
summary: An agent class has more than one fate: it is renamed twice, both renamed and removed, or renamed onto a class that already has its own recorded history in `bynk.schema.lock`.
